sign-in.alt: The sign-in page of the Example Corp Agents instance: Pi Durable Platform's mark above the instance name, a card with the button "Sign in with single sign-on", and the "Help signing in" link.

home.alt: Home for Sam Ortiz: the Agents card with "All agents" and "Catalog" links, and "Your teams" listing Data Platform (editor), his Personal workspace and Support (owner), with the sidebar's Home, All agents and Catalog, the team switcher on Support and Sam's name at the bottom.

all-agents.alt: All agents: a table of the agents of Sam's teams and personal workspace (agent, team, template, managed by the team or a service, status, last used), one awake and the rest hibernating, with a search box and the "Deploy agent" button.

catalog.alt: The Catalog: the platform templates Assistant, Policy Q&A and Writing helper, and Helpdesk triage published by the Support team, each with its owner, version and when it was updated.

deploy-dialog.alt: The "Deploy Helpdesk triage" dialog: Team set to Support, Name "Helpdesk assistant", an optional description, Model on "Template's model", and the "Deploy agent" button.

agent-overview.alt: The Overview tab of the Helpdesk assistant agent: status Hibernating, template Helpdesk triage v3, model General Large from Example AI, tools from the Calendar and Company wiki MCP servers, storage, agent ID and dates, and the start of its usage over the last 30 days.

agent-test-chat.alt: The Test tab of Helpdesk assistant: the list of chats on the left with "New chat", and an open shared conversation started by Jordan Lee: his question, a Company wiki tool call, the reply, and the line with model, tokens and time under it.

test-chat-private.alt: A new chat on a team agent's Test tab: the Shared and Private toggle above the message box, Private chosen, with the hint "Only you".

agent-settings.alt: The Settings tab of an agent: name, description, the Model picker on "Template's model", the Enabled switch, and the Danger zone with "Delete agent".

personal-workspace.alt: Sam Ortiz's personal workspace Overview: "Your own workspace: deploy agents from the catalog and use them on your own.", with the Limits card showing 1 of 5 agents and 0 of 2 running.

api-keys.alt: Account › API keys: a table of Sam's personal keys (name with its masked prefix, status, last used, expires, created), CI pipeline active and Old laptop expired, with a status filter and the "Create API key" button.

api-key-created.alt: The "API key created" dialog after creating a key named "Deploy script on my laptop": "Copy this key now.", the secret in a copy field, and the hint that it starts with pdp_00000001.

consent-page.alt: The OAuth Connect approval page for "Example Corp Chat" from chat.example.com: "See your agents and chat with them", "Create agents in your personal workspace (Personal) and in teams where you can", "Act as you, with your access", "Never with admin powers", and the Deny and Allow buttons.

connected-apps.alt: Account › Connected apps: Example Corp Chat from chat.example.com, marked Trusted, with when it was connected and last used, and its row's ⋯ menu.

team-overview.alt: The Support team's Overview: Sam's role (Owner), counts of members, owners and admins and editors, the members list, and Recent changes from the audit log.

team-members.alt: Team settings › Members for Support: members with their roles, the "Add member" button, and one open invite.

team-templates.alt: The Support team's Templates page: Helpdesk triage (published) and Release notes writer (private), with the "New template" button.

template-versions.alt: The Versions tab of Helpdesk triage: versions 3, 2 and 1 with their notes, model and date, and the "New version" button.

template-submit.alt: A team template waiting for review: the "Waiting for review" notice and the "Withdraw the request" action on its page.

team-models.alt: The Support team's Models page, Models tab: platform models published to the team and one of the team's own, marked as the team's.

team-provider-add.alt: The "Add provider" dialog on a team's Models › Providers tab: type, name, an https base URL on the company network, the API key and extra headers.

team-mcp-servers.alt: The Support team's MCP servers page, Available tab: the team's own Ticket search server listed first, then platform servers published to the team.

service-accounts.alt: The Support team's Service accounts: helpdesk-chat (editor, enabled, used minutes ago) and reports-bot (member, disabled), each with 1 of 2 keys active, and "Create service account".

service-account-key-created.alt: The "Key created" dialog for the helpdesk-chat service account: "Copy this key now.", the secret in a copy field with the hint that it starts with pdp_sa_00000001, and "Next: finish the rotation".

team-usage.alt: The Support team's Usage page: the period, Group by Agent, totals for requests, input and output tokens and estimated cost, and a table per agent, two of them service-managed.

team-audit.alt: Team settings › Audit log for Support: entries such as "Changed service account", "Read a private conversation" with its reason, "Deployed agent" and "Created service account key", with the Area, Person and Date filters.

admin-users.alt: Admin › Users: a table of people (name, email, platform role, status, teams, last sign-in) with the admin sidebar groups People and Records, and Settings.

admin-user-detail.alt: Admin › Users › Jordan Lee: Profile and access (platform role, email, first and last sign-in), Teams (his Personal workspace as owner, Support as member) and Connected apps (Example Corp Chat).

admin-teams.alt: Admin › Teams: Data Platform and IT Operations, then personal workspaces named by their owners and badged Personal, with members, owners and status, the Status and Kind filters, and the "Create team" button.

admin-create-team.alt: The "Create team" dialog: name Data Platform, slug data-platform, a description, and the first owner's email.

admin-personal-workspace.alt: Admin › Teams › Sam Ortiz's personal workspace: the Overview, Limits, Agents and Settings tabs, 1 of 5 agents and 0 of 2 running, the "Audit this workspace" card, recent changes and its owner.

admin-team-agents.alt: Admin › Teams › Support › Agents, as a platform admin: the team's two service-managed chat assistants and two team agents, with template, managed by, status and last used, each linking to its read-only page.

admin-templates-review.alt: Admin › Templates: "Waiting for review" with Release notes writer from the Data Platform team, then "Every template" with each one's owner, status and version.

admin-review-dialog.alt: The review dialog for a team template: Approve and Reject, with the "Note to the team" field required to reject.

admin-models-providers.alt: Admin › Models, Providers tab: Example AI (OpenAI-compatible), Example Corp LLM gateway (Anthropic-compatible) and the Support team's own model server, with base URL, owner, access through the platform, status and model count, the Owner filter and "Add provider".

admin-provider-models.alt: A provider's Models tab with the "Discover models" list: models the provider offers, some already added, checkboxes to add others.

admin-model-edit.alt: The "Edit model" form: name, context window, max output tokens, Accepts images, Reasoning, input and output price per million tokens, and "Who may use it" with All teams and Personal workspaces.

admin-mcp-servers.alt: Admin › MCP servers: platform servers and one team's own (Owner filter on All owners), with access mode, who may use it and tool count, and "Add MCP server".

admin-mcp-server-tools.alt: An MCP server's Tools tab: its tools with their descriptions, the last time they were read, and "Refresh tools".

admin-settings.alt: Admin › Settings: the Personal workspaces section (switches, Max agents 5, Max running at once 2, Monthly budget) and the start of Team providers and MCP servers.

admin-trusted-apps.alt: Admin › Settings: Team providers and MCP servers with the private network 10.20.0.0/16, and Trusted apps with one app, its client ID https://chat.example.com/oauth/client-metadata.json and the label "Company chat, run by IT".

admin-usage.alt: Admin › Usage: usage across teams grouped by Team, with requests, tokens and estimated cost per team over the last 30 days.

admin-audit.alt: Admin › Audit log: recent entries across the platform with actor, how they acted, action and target, the filters and "Export CSV".

agent-conversations-tab.alt: An agent's Conversations tab as a platform admin, for an agent in Sam's personal workspace: every thread with its visibility (one private, three shared), who started it, the people in it and its last activity; each title reads "Title hidden", with a "Read…" button.

read-conversation-dialog.alt: The "Read this conversation?" dialog: a reason typed in the required field (10 to 500 characters), the note that the read is recorded in the team's audit log, which the owner can see, and "Read conversation".
